qa_pairs.question: What is the current operational status of the Graham cluster and what system has replaced it?
qa_pairs.answer: The Graham cluster has been retired and replaced by a new system named Nibi. Users should check the Infrastructure renewal page for details regarding the transition.

qa_pairs.question: What are some of the site-specific policies governing job execution and internet access on the Graham cluster?
qa_pairs.answer: On the Graham cluster, compute nodes cannot access the internet by policy, though exceptions can be requested by contacting technical support. Crontab functionality is not offered. Each job must have a duration of at least one hour (five minutes for test jobs) and no more than 168 hours (seven days). Furthermore, a user is limited to a maximum of 1000 jobs, encompassing both running and queued, at any given moment.
